deltas.reason: The pinned Oxc compiler preserves the module opt-out even for a function carrying use memo. Direct native transforms produce no gates in every mode. Babel accepted this explicit function opt-in despite the module opt-out.
deltas.editEffect: The opt-in remains unchanged. Its broken status keeps all lint runs nonzero, including --fix runs that previously passed without justified revalidation.

deltas.reason: Targeted neutralization leaves the module opt-out intact. Oxc honors that module guard in all mode while Babel accepted the neutralized function.
deltas.editEffect: Remove only the ordinary function opt-out instead of adding a justification. Preserve the file directive and the independently justified Protected directive.

deltas.reason: The individual justified probe preserves the module opt-out, so the pinned Oxc compiler does not accept the probed function.
deltas.editEffect: Report-only: preserve the directive and its exact original justification even with --fix.

deltas.reason: Babel rejects the TypeScript angle assertion with (BuildHIR::lowerExpression) Handle TSTypeAssertion expressions. Oxc erases TypeScript before compiling and accepts this function in all mode.
deltas.editEffect: Justify the original ordinary opt-out instead of removing it. Revalidation remains report-only after the fix.
